title: 2016 HMMT November Guts Problem 4
statement:
A square can be divided into four congruent figures as shown:

For how many \(n\) with \(1 \leq n \leq 100\) can a unit square be divided into \(n\) congruent figures?

[Diagram omitted from this imported transcription; consult the HMMT archive while reviewing the problem.]

solutions.text:
Answer: 100
We can divide the square into congruent rectangles for all \(n\), so the answer is 100 .
